title_zh: 课后请朋友顺路送到街口

scenario.goal_zh: 说明临时交通困难并与朋友确认顺路搭车及下车位置

context_zh: 晚课结束后雨果的汽车无法启动，他已经安排修车人员处理，想请同学扎拉顺路送他回去。
author: author-phase06-c

sentences.speaker: Hugo
sentences.text: Could I beg a favour? My car will not start, and the garage is collecting it in the morning.

sentences.speaker: Zara
sentences.text: Do you need a lift? I am going past your street.

sentences.speaker: Hugo
sentences.text: Yes, please. You can drop me at the corner; there is no need to turn into the narrow lane.

sentences.speaker: Zara
sentences.text: That works. Get your bag, and we can leave now.

targets.sense_zh: 恳求，请求；此处为客气地请求帮忙
